verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a commercial contract-management SaaS, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for a software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source availability, a public repository, or an open-source license. Public APIs, webhooks and llms.txt docs are integration surfaces, not open source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
